adjudication.rationale: Looking at app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35, the code is `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item has nil content (i.content is nil), calling .scrub on nil will raise a NoMethodError, which would abort processing of all subsequent items in the feed. This is a real bug - RSS/ATOM feeds can have items without content (only title/link), and the code doesn't handle this case with a fallback to description or by skipping the item.
